options.name: api_token
options.description: Bearer token for authentication. Use this or C(session_cookie).

options.name: host
options.description: Base URL of the Semaphore server including scheme (e.g. C(http://localhost)).

options.name: integration_id
options.description: ID of the integration the matcher belongs to.

options.name: matcher_id
options.description: ID of the matcher to delete.

options.name: port
options.description: Port where the Semaphore API is exposed (e.g. C(3000)).

options.name: project_id
options.description: ID of the project that owns the integration.

options.name: session_cookie
options.description: Session cookie for authentication. Use this or C(api_token).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate TLS certificates when using HTTPS.
